extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone. The server serves one surface profile per launch, selected by the MEISTER_PROFILE environment variable: profiles lists one invocation entry per declared profile, and the bare invocation (no environment) launches defaultProfile.

profiles.description: Default. Four read-only tools: the lane check, project list and inspect, and the canon census.
Core plus project creation and cast identity records and locks.
Core plus scenes and systems authoring and level composition.
Core plus dialogue, reaction profiles, story arcs, playtest generation, verdict records, and emit.
Core plus asset intake, routing, and keeper-chain inspection.
Core plus content standards, accessibility, playtest, and defect records.
Core plus release handoff and channel credential references. Opt-in only; never part of a bundle.
Bundle: core, systems, and narrative together, for floor production.
Every tool. For conformance and audit only.

description: Qompass AI's SFW game maker: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) holding authoring and project state for SFW games — scaffolding, cast and canon, systems and narrative authoring, asset routing, playtest, and release handoff — with a live lane gate that refuses NSFW and unclassified input before any authoring. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Meister does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Meister
